papers.title: Map-Level Inference of Primordial Gravitational Waves from the CMB with Spherical Neural Networks
papers.summary: Spherical graph convolutional network infers tensor-to-scalar ratio directly from simulated multifrequency CMB B-mode maps, reducing RMSE by 1.3 times versus a bandpower likelihood.

papers.title: A Homogeneous Benchmark of Exoplanet Mass-Radius Relations
papers.summary: Benchmark of 963 exoplanets compares power laws, probabilistic models and ML regressors; random forest gives lowest RMSE but empirical relations remain competitive.

papers.title: Cross-Dataset Inference of Central-Satellite Classification and Host Halo Masses from Galaxy neighbours with Machine Learning
papers.comment: 15 pages, 16 Figures (including appendix), comments are welcome
papers.summary: XGBoost trained on IllustrisTNG neighbour distances and stellar masses classifies central/satellite galaxies and estimates halo masses, generalizing to EAGLE after domain alignment.

papers.title: Surrogate Modeling and Reduced-Order Methods in Gravitational-Wave Physics and Numerical Relativity: From Spectral Representations to Adaptive Compression
papers.summary: Review of reduced-order modeling and surrogate waveforms for gravitational-wave data analysis, covering projection methods, approximation limits and scientific machine learning routes.

papers.title: Thermodynamics of gas giants accreting via shocks: the role of molecular hydrogen dissociation
papers.summary: Physics-informed neural network trained on radiation-hydrodynamics simulations supplies post-shock boundary conditions to MESA, yielding brighter and more magnetic accreting gas giants than cold-start models.

papers.title: Interpretable attention-based neural posterior estimation for fast radio burst cosmology
papers.summary: Attention-based neural posterior estimator compresses FRB catalogues and generates seven-parameter posteriors in 0.036 s, matching MCMC at about 10^6 speedup.

papers.title: Geodesic-informed neural networks for testing spacetimes with S2
papers.summary: Geodesic-informed neural network models S2's orbit around Sagittarius A* by optimization, reproducing exact-solver parameter estimates and finding no significant deviation from Schwarzschild.

papers.title: automodel: A Skill for Agentic Model Discovery
papers.summary: Presents automodel, a portable agent skill letting commercial coding agents discover models, with astrophysics case studies among five domains.

papers.title: NEXONN: Advancing the NEXOTRANS Exoplanet Atmospheric Retrieval Framework with Transformer-Based Neural Posterior Estimation for JWST Transmission Spectroscopy of WASP-39b
papers.comment: 28 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables. Revised and resubmitted to The Astronomical Journal. We thank the anonymous referee for their constructive comments. Further comments are welcome
papers.summary: Transformer-conditioned normalizing flows replace nested sampling for JWST exoplanet atmospheric retrieval, matching PyMultiNest on WASP-39b within seconds.

papers.title: Searching the Pareto Front: Multi-Objective Retrieval for Heterogeneous Scientific Modalities
papers.summary: Multi-objective Pareto fusion of separately trained modality embeddings is compared with a foundation model for galaxy retrieval across spectra and survey images.

papers.title: JEPA for astronomy: multi-survey spectral alignment puts stellar parameters on the leading principal axes
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to AAS journals. Comments welcome
papers.summary: Varying only the alignment loss for multi-survey stellar spectra, a JEPA objective yields the most linearly recoverable stellar parameters and abundances.

papers.title: Isotropic diffuse gamma-ray flux limits from Carpet-3 experiment data using neural networks with domain adaptation
papers.summary: Neural network with unsupervised domain adaptation separates photons from hadrons in Carpet-3 data, giving diffuse gamma-ray flux limits from 100 TeV to 10 PeV.

excluded.title: LEMUR: A Searchable Web Archive of Deep Chandra Images of Galaxies and Galaxy Clusters
